preconditions.name: pool_divergent_raw_f_range
preconditions.description: median raw-F RANGE across seeds clears the divergent-menu floor

preconditions.name: envelope_size_lower
preconditions.description: median MECH-448 demotion envelope size >= ENVELOPE_MIN (room for Go/No-Go to drop a safety + a stale candidate AND leave >= 2 survivors to arbitrate)
preconditions.control: adaptive-floor envelope over the fixed F menu (retry-selected)

preconditions.name: envelope_excludes
preconditions.description: median excluded_count >= 1 (the envelope is not an all-admit no-op; F-poor excluded)
preconditions.control: F-poor candidates below the adaptive mean share

preconditions.name: monostrategy_baseline_off_entropy
preconditions.description: ARM_OFF committed-class entropy stays BELOW the monostrategy ceiling (headroom)
preconditions.control: fixed F menu -> F-argmin is a fixed class

preconditions.name: demotion_main_effect_lift
preconditions.description: demotion main-effect entropy lift clears the floor (the lever genuinely converts)
preconditions.control: within-eligible argmin over the varying modulatory favorite

preconditions.name: gonogo_suppression_engages
preconditions.description: median Go/No-Go suppression on ARM_BOTH >= 1 candidate (the gate fires)
preconditions.control: safety+staleness No-Go injected on envelope members

preconditions.name: cross_seed_estimable
preconditions.description: >= 2 valid seeds so the SD-of-delta interaction gate is estimable
preconditions.control: matched contexts replayed across arms per seed
